summary: Smoke contract validator skips catalog (allowlist omits it)
description:
### Smoke contract-validator allowlist omits catalog

`smoke/contract_validation_test.go:~59` gates response contract-validation on `strings.Contains(" inventory commerce payments access ", " "+service+" ")` — **catalog is not in the allowlist**, so `validateServiceResponse` returns early for every `/api/catalog/*` response reached through the gateway in smoke. Catalog responses ARE still validated in-process (catalog's `NewRouter` wraps handlers in the response validator, ADR-028), so this is not a correctness hole — but the smoke suite gives catalog reads a false sense of end-to-end contract coverage. Surfaced during TKT-101 ai-review (kimi-k3): the new `/api/catalog/public/venues` smoke assertion runs the validator as a no-op.

**Acceptance:** add `catalog` to the allowlist; FIRST verify no existing catalog endpoint drifts once validated (the reviewer flagged this may surface latent drift on endpoints never smoke-validated). If drift surfaces, fix the drift or scope the change per endpoint.

Origin: TKT-101 ai-review incidental finding (pre-existing, not introduced by TKT-101).
